name: Alice Hemworth
source:
Alice is the neighborhood’s favorite daughter. Her family moved to the Mid-Levels when she was 5. Coming from a family of shopkeepers, Alice always wanted to open her own pastry shop.

She was finally able to make her dream come true when she took over Taka Coffee House by borrowing a loan, and she has been working every day since then.
